article.headline: Dangerous storms threaten Queensland and New South Wales with giant hail tornadoes
article.summary: Severe thunderstorms carrying the risk of tornadoes and hail larger than golf balls are targeting parts of Queensland and northern New South Wales today.
article.body:
Destructive winds reaching up to 125km/h are expected to accompany the storms as they develop through this afternoon and evening. The Bureau of Meteorology has placed multiple regions in the firing line for potentially volatile conditions, with residents in saturated areas of south-east Queensland facing an increased risk of flash flooding due to the forecasted heavy rainfall.

These warnings are critical for communities as the atmospheric conditions shift rapidly. Meteorologist Jonathon How indicated that the weather event poses significant dangers to the listed forecast districts, ranging from the Illawarra and Hunter regions down to the Northern Tablelands and beyond. For those in the path of the storm system, the threat of giant hail larger than golf balls and possible tornadoes highlights the severity of this weather pattern.

According to Nine.com.au, the areas under notice include the Mid North Coast, Central Tablelands, Southern Tablelands, and the North West Slopes and Plains. Queensland regions such as the Central Highlands and Coalfields, Maranoa and Warrego, and the Darling Downs and Granite Belt are also included in the warnings. Brisbane residents have already experienced muggy conditions with temperatures climbing into the high 20s.

The weather system is not expected to remain stationary. Meteorologists anticipate the storms will migrate north throughout Queensland and track across northern Australia tomorrow, continuing the period of instability. Authorities advise staying updated as the storms progress across these regions.

article.headline: Scott Parker Nears West Ham Manager Role After Nuno Espirito Santo Sacking
article.summary: West Ham United have dismissed Nuno Espirito Santo after 13 Championship games, with former player Scott Parker in advanced talks to take over.
article.body:
Scott Parker, who made 129 appearances for the Hammers between 2007 and 2011, is close to being appointed as the new head coach. Parker brings extensive experience in the division, having previously secured promotion to the Premier League with Fulham, Bournemouth, and Burnley. He left his position at Burnley last April when their relegation was confirmed.

The decision to change leadership comes as West Ham sit eighth in the Championship, six points behind the league leaders and four points off the automatic promotion spots. The club's board stated that a change in the dugout was necessary to ensure their promotion objectives and expectations remain on track after winning only six of their first 13 matches.

According to Sky Sports, Nuno Espirito Santo’s departure followed consecutive home losses at London Stadium, including a 3-2 defeat to Southampton and a 3-1 loss to West Brom. Supporters at the stadium voiced their frustrations during the final match of his tenure. West Ham United confirmed in a club statement that Nuno has left his position with immediate effect.

While the recruitment process for a new head coach is underway, current staff members Mark Noble, Steve Potts, and Gerard Prenderville have been tasked with preparing the squad for the upcoming matches. The team is scheduled to play Cardiff City away this Tuesday, with the match broadcast live on Sky Sports. Following the trip to Cardiff, West Ham face Blackburn on November 7, Preston on November 21, and Portsmouth on November 24.

article.headline: Ciaron Maher trainer routs Melbourne Cup as Point of Law wins easily
article.summary: Point of Law, formerly owned by King Charles III, won the 3200m Melbourne Cup under jockey Ethan Brown at Flemington.
article.body:
Trainer Ciaron Maher achieved a historic feat by producing the top three finishers in the A$10.2 million Lexus Melbourne Cup. While stablemate Royal Supremacy surged to a massive 12-length lead during the middle stages of the 3200m race, jockey Ethan Brown remained patient in the chasing pack before Point of Law roared through on the inside to secure a victory by nearly four lengths. The runner-up and third-place horses, Zahraan and Juja Kibo, completed a dominant podium sweep for the Maher stable.

This victory holds significant intrigue as Point of Law was previously bred and raced by King Charles III and Queen Camilla. Royal policy barred the King from maintaining ownership alongside the current syndicate, leading to a sale in July estimated between A$2 million and A$3 million. The new owners, including former AFL player Chris Judd and his wife Bec, saw their investment pay off immediately as the three-year-old thoroughbred proved his status as a budding superstar following his previous win in the Geelong Cup.

Jockey Ethan Brown, who returned to the sport after a serious injury left him hospitalized in 2023, described the win as every jockey's dream. The race day at Flemington attracted tens of thousands of spectators under sunny conditions, featuring a pre-race performance by Robbie Williams. The event was not without incident, as the horse Asterix was scratched on race day after a stable worker administered forbidden medication for muscle soreness. Despite these complications, the prestigious event proceeded to crown a clear winner in front of a massive crowd.

article.headline: Hackers crank European supermarket fridges to 50C in mass food supply attack
article.summary: Hackers targeted supermarket refrigeration units across seven European countries and the UK on Monday by remotely increasing temperatures, causing potential food spoilage.
article.body:
Thermostats in supermarket freezers across seven European countries were remotely surged to 50C (122F) during a widespread cyber-attack on Monday. While the full extent of the damage is still being assessed, the incident follows an early October attack in France that destroyed fresh and frozen food estimated at millions of euros in value.

The disruption of food supply chains poses a significant threat to consumer confidence and infrastructure security. Experts warn that the simplicity of these hacks—where attackers manipulate internet-connected refrigeration controls without needing complex malware—leaves supermarkets highly vulnerable. The National Cyber Security Centre in the UK confirmed it is aware of instances where vulnerable technology was exploited in the country and has been working to alert affected organizations.

Investigations remain ongoing, with officials currently unable to confirm the identity of the perpetrators. According to The Guardian, security experts suggest the culprits could range from state-based actors, such as those linked to Russia or China, to lone-wolf hackers testing their capabilities. The attacks exploited remote management systems that cyber-security researchers had previously identified as vulnerable due to outdated or unsecure configurations.

Dr. Richard Horne, chief executive of the NCSC, stated it is too early to attribute the attacks to a specific group. He emphasized that the events serve as a critical reminder for businesses to upgrade legacy technology that has not been kept secure or disconnected from the internet. As intelligence agencies monitor a broader campaign of potential sabotage in Europe, the vulnerability of everyday connected devices, including ovens and heating systems, remains a significant concern for the coming months.

article.headline: Americans head to polls in referendum on Trump's second term agenda
article.summary: Voters across the United States are casting ballots today to determine which party controls Congress for the remainder of Donald Trump's presidency.
article.body:
Record numbers of Americans have already cast early votes before polling stations opened nationwide this Tuesday, 3 November. These midterm elections serve as a direct referendum on the current administration's direction, with the political landscape shaped by an ongoing war alongside Israel against Iran that has fueled a global energy crisis and regional conflict. While the president does not appear on the ballot himself, the outcomes in key Senate and House races will dictate his ability to push his legislative agenda over the final two years of his term.

The results of today's voting will prove critical for the balance of power in Washington. Democrats are currently pushing for victories in historically Republican-leaning districts that have remained uncompetitive for decades. For voters, the stakes remain high as the election determines the trajectory of national policy in the face of widespread unpopularity regarding current administrative choices and the high costs associated with ongoing military engagements.

Polls began closing in the first states, Indiana and Kentucky, at 6 p.m. ET (3 p.m. PT), marking the beginning of the reporting process. According to the Associated Press, additional results will continue to roll in throughout the evening as more states finish voting. The final polls will close in Alaska and Hawaii at midnight ET (9 p.m. PT). Official tallies of elected members of Congress will be updated as races are called by the Associated Press, with data reflected in live tracking charts.

article.body:
A staggering $1 million bet placed by Irish billionaire JP McManus on Hopewell Rock resulted in a complete loss after the horse failed to secure a place in the top four. The gamble was set to yield a massive $9.6 million payout for the 75-year-old, but the horse finished well behind the lead pack on Tuesday night at Flemington. 

This outcome reshaped the day for punters and professional bettors alike, as the race served as a major test of staying power. The event highlights the extreme volatility of high-stakes horse racing, where even significant financial backing cannot guarantee a return against the performance of the field on the track. 

Winning trainer Ciaron Maher celebrated a dominant performance as he secured a trifecta, with three of his horses taking the top three spots in the race. Maher noted that while he was confident in his stable, the distance Royal Supremacy built up during the event was unexpected. According to the Sydney Morning Herald, the trainer credited his team's execution in what he described as a true test of stamina for all involved. 

As the racing circuit moves forward, the results from Flemington will be analyzed for their impact on future major events and trainer rankings. The focus now shifts to the aftermath of the race for the winning stable and the notable financial fallout for high-profile investors who backed the unsuccessful favourite.

article.headline: HMD Unveils Nokia 2360 Flip Featuring Dedicated SOS Button and Remote Control
article.summary: HMD has launched the Nokia 2360 Flip in the Philippines for PHP 2,790, offering 2G connectivity and specialized tools for students and seniors.
article.body:
A single press of the rear-mounted SOS button initiates an automatic call to a primary emergency contact while simultaneously broadcasting alerts to up to five pre-set numbers. This hardware-integrated safety feature anchors a device designed specifically for school students and senior citizens who require simpler communication tools.

The phone introduces the Family Assist feature, which enables designated relatives to remotely manage the device settings. This allows guardians or family members to add contacts, set daily reminders, and adjust volume levels from afar. These capabilities are intended to ease the burden of technical management for users who may be less comfortable with complex smartphone interfaces.

According to GSMArena and YugaTech, the device sports a 2.8-inch main display, a 1.77-inch external screen, and a removable 1,450mAh battery capable of providing up to 27.5 hours of talk time. Other hardware specifications include a QVGA camera, a 3.5mm headphone jack, 4MB of internal storage, and support for microSD cards up to 32GB. While the phone features Hearing Aid Compatibility, its 2G-only connectivity limits functionality in regions where such networks have already been discontinued.

The Nokia 2360 Flip is currently available in the Philippines via the official Shopee store in Burgundy and Grey color options for PHP 2,790. HMD has not yet provided information regarding broader global availability or pricing beyond the initial Philippine launch.

article.headline: Met Eireann issues Status Yellow fog warning for eight Irish counties tonight
article.summary: Met Eireann has issued a Status Yellow fog warning for eight counties, covering the period from 10pm Monday until 10am Tuesday.
article.body:
Temperatures are set to plummet to as low as -1C tonight, creating conditions where dense fog will likely become widespread. This overnight chill brings a risk of frost as skies remain mostly clear, leading to reduced visibility for anyone traveling across the affected regions.

Motorists should prepare for difficult driving conditions as the dense mist and fog are expected to persist through the early morning. With visibility significantly impacted, road safety is a primary concern for local authorities, and commuters are advised to exercise caution throughout the duration of the alert.

According to Met Eireann, the warning applies to counties Cavan, Donegal, and Monaghan, along with all of Connacht. While the fog is forecast to clear gradually throughout Tuesday morning, it may linger in some areas until the afternoon. The cold front is accompanied by near-calm conditions, which have prompted Donegal County Council to schedule gritting for all roads on its winter maintenance list starting at 6am on Tuesday, 3rd November.

Following the clearance of the fog and frost on Tuesday, the forecaster expects the conditions to improve as the day progresses. Residents in eastern and southern coastal areas may experience slightly milder weather compared to the inland regions, but the overall cold trend remains throughout the current 12-hour warning window.

article.body:
Democrats must secure a minimum of four victories across eight battleground states—Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Maine, Michigan, Ohio, South Carolina, and Texas—to seize control of the upper chamber of Congress. While Republicans currently hold a 53-47 Senate majority, the party faces significant challenges in states previously considered safely red, according to reporting from NBC News. A comprehensive analysis by Time Magazine of projections from 10 election forecasters underscores the volatility, showing that these eight specific contests lack a consensus prediction from experts.

The outcome of these races holds immediate consequences for legislative power in Washington. NBC News reports that Democrats would need to flip at least two states that President Donald Trump won by double digits in 2024 to overcome their current deficit. For voters, the path to a Senate majority is defined by these high-stakes campaigns spreading into traditionally reliable Republican territory.

Time Magazine details the division among forecasters regarding individual seats. In states like Alaska and Kansas, some analysts rate races as leaning Democratic while others view them as toss-ups. Maine and Ohio also remain competitive, with a majority of forecasters favoring Democratic challengers Troy Jackson and Sherrod Brown respectively, though major organizations including the Cook Political Report continue to label them as toss-ups. Michigan represents a different landscape, where most forecasters lean toward Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, while the Fox News Power Rankings maintain it as a toss-up.

The election cycle reaches its conclusion as voters head to the polls on Nov. 3. Final results will confirm whether the projected Democratic momentum is enough to shift the Senate majority or if Republican incumbents retain their seats.

article.headline: Ravens sign Kedon Slovis to bolster quarterback room after multiple injury hits
article.summary: The Baltimore Ravens are signing 25-year-old quarterback Kedon Slovis from the Green Bay Packers practice squad to address a depleted roster.
article.body:
Kedon Slovis enters the Baltimore locker room having attempted just two passes during his two-game professional debut with the Arizona Cardinals last season. The 25-year-old signal-caller joins the Ravens following a chaotic Sunday outing against the Buffalo Bills that left the team scrambling for healthy options at the position. 

This roster move provides immediate depth for Baltimore as they navigate a string of injuries affecting their core quarterbacks. Lamar Jackson is sidelined indefinitely with a thumb injury, while Tyler Huntley is managing a toe issue that kept him out of Monday’s practice. Furthermore, Joe Fagnano, who finished the game in Buffalo, appeared on the injury report with an ankle concern after absorbing a hit from defensive lineman Ed Oliver.

According to Tom Pelissero, the Ravens secured Slovis directly from the Green Bay Packers practice squad. The transition to the new environment may be eased by familiarity; Slovis is set to reunite with Baltimore’s quarterback coach, Israel Woolfork, who served as his position coach during their time together in Arizona. Additionally, Ravens wide receivers coach Keary Colbert worked with Slovis during his collegiate tenure at USC. Before entering the professional ranks as an undrafted player in 2024, Slovis completed a college career that included stints at USC, Pittsburgh, and BYU.

To further solidify their quarterback situation, the team also added Austin Reed to the practice squad on Monday. As the organization manages these mounting health concerns, the Ravens prepare to host the Jacksonville Jaguars this Thursday night.
